name: Measured performance improvement
description: Improve one measurable performance budget with a repeatable before result, focused change, and honest variance note.

outcomes.description: A representative workload has a repeatable before and after measurement tied to one budget.
The optimization preserves correctness, accessibility, and the declared user behavior.

prerequisites.description: The latency, size, memory, rendering, or throughput budget and workload are explicit.
prerequisites.check: Choose one representative workload and record how it is measured.

prerequisites.description: A stable before measurement exists without changing production or hiding slower cases.
prerequisites.check: Capture baseline conditions and variance in a safe environment.

lanes.objective: Define the budget, representative workload, baseline, and bottleneck hypothesis.
Apply one focused optimization while preserving behavior and measurement shape.
Repeat the same workload, check the budget, and inspect correctness and accessibility.

qualityGates.description: Before and after measurements use the same workload, conditions, and reporting method.
The stated budget improves or the receipt explains variance and why no claim is made.
Relevant behavior, accessibility, and regression checks remain green after the optimization.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response while measuring performance.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; use safe synthetic or existing preview data instead.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior to improve a metric.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Performance work must remain reversible and behavior-preserving.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Return to the last known-good integration point when the measurement is not repeatable or correctness regresses.
rescueSteps: Preserve paired measurements and workload facts.
Keep the optimization isolated from unrelated cleanup.
Record the variance or regression and abandon an unsupported claim.
stopConditions: The workload or budget cannot be repeated.
The optimization changes correctness or accessibility.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private user data.
Record metric names, units, and safe summaries only.
